title.narrative: Engagement Facility for Funding Window Management Team (Secretariat)

description.narrative: This Engagement Facility is established to enhance the quality, integration, and strategic value of UNDP interventions, supported by UNDP Funding Windows, across all themes underpinning the six signature solutions by ensuring a robust technical accompaniment and administration of UNDP Funding Windows - UNDP’s primary vehicle for multi year thematic funding. The project is further established to ensure proper implementation of the UNDP Funding Windows Management Arrangements. To that end, this Engagement Facility aims to ensure quality, efficiency, and strategic value of UNDP Funding Windows operations by providing efficient and effective (1) Strategic planning and coordination for Funding Window offer with substantive leads and stakeholders, (2) Institutional mechanisms, operational and substantive capacities for ensuring management efficiencies in pipeline development and implementation, (3) Implement Fund Management and strengthen partnership engagement and commitment and (4) Integrate and enhance result management, communication, reporting and partner visibility.

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
